title: Evaluating and Improving TROPICS Millimeter-Wave Sounder's Precipitation Estimate Over Ocean

High Revisit-Rate Tropical Cyclone Observations From the NASA TROPICS Satellite Constellation Mission: This article describes results from the TROPICS constellation of "small sat" microwave radiometers designed for atmospheric and tropical cyclone measurements. The mission objectives and accomplishments are discussed in detail.
